answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should charge every identity in verifiable work, not in words: each new account must earn its standing through contributions countersigned by unrelated peers over time. Clones can echo the same fable a thousand times, but they cannot fake a long history of distinct, attested deeds — the cost of growing a thousand separate reputations dwarfs any reward. Weight the signal of real work, and the echo chamber starves.
